Summary: Blocks route selection when the pull request packet omits key evidence or changed-surface context.
PassCriteria: The pull request packet names changed surfaces, proof, rollback notes, and reviewer asks clearly enough to choose a governed lane.
FailCriteria: Any route would rely on guesswork because the packet omits changed-surface, proof, rollback, or reviewer-context data.
EscalationRule: Return the workflow to the author and do not normalize the packet implicitly.
